title: Woman Sexually Harasses Officers After She Assaults Flight Attendant
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 1st, 2023. Officers were dispatched to the airport about an assault of a flight attendant. When the officers arrived on the plane, the woman was clearly intoxicated and had been moved up to the front of the plane so she would stop causing a disturbance to other passengers. It was stated that the woman had taken multiple shots before boarding the flight & she was also drinking out of other passenger's drinks. The woman and her mom had to be escorted off the plane. FBI agents were also called to the airport due to them believing it was a domestic threat. The FBI conducted multiple interviews with the flight attendant & the witness and it was stated that she assaulted the flight attendant's left side of her face due to a punch and will be pursuing federal charges(although the interviews were not recorded). While they were conducting the interviews, the woman was making various sexual remarks to the officers and offering sexual services, she also continued to act irrationally all the way to the jail. 

#news #police #arrest
